newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Weifu sees unaudited 1996 net of 66.50 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Weifu sees unaudited 1996 net of 66.50 mln yuan.

text.p: Jiangsu-based automobile parts producer Weifu Fuel Injection Co Ltd had unaudited net profits of 66.50 million yuan last year on stronger sales, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The company posted after-tax profits of 62.98 million yuan for 1995 versus 53.37 million yuan in 1994, under international accounting standards.

The official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that the earnings advance last year was fuelled by the company's drives to expand sales, improve after-sales service and upgrade the quality of its products.
Weifu forecast its net profits would grow 10-15 percent year-on-year in 1997 on stronger demand, he said.
He said the company last year received purchase orders valued at 800 million yuan mostly for delivery in 1997.
Weifu's 1996 interim net was 33.20 million yuan, up 13.07 percent compared with 29.37 million yuan in the 1995 period, under international accounting standards.
